about_the_game:
The streets hum with life, the air thick with the scent of sizzling sauce. A humble griddle, a swift hand, and a single sheet of cold noodles—this is where a simple meal becomes legend.

From the first light of dawn to the peak of the lunch rush, your stall stands amidst the rhythm of the city, feeding hurried workers, curious passersby, and devoted regulars alike. The secret to success?

Precision, speed, and a touch of mastery. With each flick of the wrist, each brush of sauce, you transform ordinary ingredients into something extraordinary.

A battle against time and flame 

The griddle crackles, customers gather, and every second counts. Wait too long, and the noodles burn; rush the process, and the flavor falls flat. Balance speed and skill to craft the perfect bite.

Silky-smooth game feel

A single motion sends the noodles flipping through the air, sauce gliding into place, every movement refined to feel as effortless as a seasoned chef at work.

The soul of the modern street stall

A stainless steel cart glistens under the sun with trays of ingredients neatly arranged. No neon lights or festival crowds—just the pulse of the everyday, the warmth of familiarity, the comfort of a meal prepared with care.

A guardian of flavor by your side

Your charming, mischievous assistant lends a paw, fetching ingredients, luring in customers, and adding a bit of personality to your bustling stall.

From humble beginnings to culinary mastery

With each sale, your skills sharpen, and your stall thrives. Upgrade to a fine grill plate and finer snacks, a griddle that sings under your touch, and watch as your reputation spreads.

A street stall is more than just a place to eat—it is a stage where fire and flavor dance, where each dish carries a story. Kaolengmian Legend is an ode to the art of simple, perfect cooking. Step into the heat, feel the rhythm, and let your legend unfold.

name: Kaolengmian Legend

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GS
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Kaolengmian, aka Grilled Cold Noodles, is a famous Chinese street food. You will take on the role of a street food vendor, crafting delicious, sizzling kaolengmian! Select ingredients, brush sauce, flip noodles, and win over customers with your cooking skills!
supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
